name: Camping 101: Skinning

angles.text: Learn basic cooking from a culinary trainer. Knowing how to build a campfire is essential when setting up a campsite in the wild.

faq.answer: You learn to make a portable Camp Chair for resting in the wilderness.
faq.q: What do you learn from Camping 101: Skinning?

faq.answer: Townsfolk generally object to camps in town squares and city streets. Head into the wilds to pitch yours.
faq.q: Can you set up a camp in town?

faq.answer: Yes. A campsite needs a lit campfire. Cooking trainers across Azeroth can teach you to kindle one.
faq.q: Do you need a campfire to make camp?

faq.answer: Cooking trainers can teach you to prepare food and start a simple campfire with flint and wood.
faq.q: Where can you learn how to make a campfire?

aliases: where can i use camp chair
faq.answer: Open ground in the wilderness lets you pitch camp without disturbing town residents or blocking local roads and settlements.
faq.q: Why must you head into the wilderness to set up camp?

faq.answer: Skinners work hides and leather taken from beasts. These materials suit portable outdoor seating such as a Camp Chair.
faq.q: How does skinning relate to making a camp chair?

sections.body: Hides gathered on the road can be put to use. With the materials at hand, you learn to make a portable Camp Chair for journeys through Azeroth. Townsfolk object when travelers pitch camp in city centers, so take this craft into the open wilds.
sections.title: Comforts of the Trail

sections.body: A campfire is the first need at a campsite in the wild. Its flames bring warmth and shelter from the elements. If you have not learned basic cooking, visit a cooking trainer to learn how to kindle a fire in the field.
sections.title: The Essential Campfire

summary: Out in the wilds, you learn to make a Camp Chair and prepare a campsite. You need hides, open ground away from town, and a campfire.
